model.name: Live code-stamp of lastAdvancedAt on a marked-declaration commit (the LIVE half of code-recency)
model.description: The backfill code-recency (lastAdvancedAt = MAX of the checklist-changing commit + the commit touching the task's MARKED DECLARATION, git-derived) is shipped. F1 is the LIVE half: when a CODE commit touches a task's marked declaration, lastAdvancedAt is stamped LIVE (source='code') THROUGH THE SEAM at commit-time, so the pin's code-recency moves without waiting for a backfill re-run. RESIDUAL named: 'code-file' OVER-CREDIT on a SHARED file (e.g. unit-controller.ts, where -L cannot scope to the marked decl -> file-level attribution), DETECTABLE via the source label ('code-file' vs 'code') so it is visible not silent. Architect follow-up F1 (design-r40.18-followups.md).

model.crossRefNote: lastAdvancedAt recency family: R40.18 (pin derivation = max lastAdvancedAt) + R40.45 (live-on-advance endpoint) + R40.46 (this = live code-stamp). Source labels seam / git-backfill / code / code-file = honesty-by-provenance (a reader/audit knows the stamp's precision + any over-credit). campaignScope=OUTSIDE.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A CODE commit touching a task's MARKED DECLARATION stamps lastAdvancedAt LIVE (source='code') THROUGH THE SEAM at commit-time — the pin's code-recency moves without waiting for a backfill re-run (the live half of the shipped git-derived code-recency).

The live code-stamp routes THROUGH THE SEAM (not a bare write) and is SINGLE-SOURCE with the backfill's code-recency (both = MAX of checklist-commit + marked-declaration-commit); no 2nd stamping path that could diverge.

When -L cannot scope to the marked declaration (TS static methods etc), the fallback is FILE-level + LABELED source='code-file' so the over-credit (a whole-file commit attributed to one marked decl on a SHARED file like unit-controller.ts) is VISIBLE, never silent. The label distinguishes precise ('code') from file-fallback ('code-file').

The residual (code-file over-credit on the shared unit-controller.ts) is NAMED + detectable via the source label, tracked not hidden — a reader/audit can see which stamps are precise vs file-fallback.

Same lastAdvancedAt recency family as R40.18 (derivation) + R40.45 (live-on-advance); the source-label set = seam / git-backfill / code / code-file (honesty-by-provenance: never claim more precision than the signal supports).
